    first_half = []
    second_half = []
    
    def dfs_first(index, current):
        if index == half:
            first_half.append(current % m)
        else:
            dfs_first(index + 1, (current + values[index]) % m)
            dfs_first(index + 1, current)
    
    def dfs_second(index, current):
        if index == n:
            second_half.append((m - current) % m)
        else:
            dfs_second(index + 1, (current + values[index]) % m)
            dfs_second(index + 1, current)
    
    dfs_first(0, 0)
    dfs_second(half, 0)
    
    first_half = sorted(set(first_half))

            total = (first_half[position - 1] + s) % m
            if total > max_total:
                max_total = total
        if position < len(first_half):
            total = (first_half[position] + s) % m
